semantic_description: Total revenue or net sales; the top line of the income statement representing all income from core business activities
Direct cost of producing goods or services sold; variously labelled cost of goods sold, cost of revenue, or cost of sales
Revenue minus cost of revenue; profit remaining after direct production costs before operating expenses
Expenditures on research and development activities; a key operating expense for technology and pharmaceutical companies
Overhead and sales costs not directly tied to production; includes selling expenses and general administrative costs
Total operating expenses below gross profit; may aggregate R&D, SG&A, and other operating costs when reported as a combined line item
Profit from core business operations before interest and taxes; also known as EBIT. May be reported directly or derived as gross profit minus total operating expenses.
Interest expense on debt obligations; typically reported below operating income as a non-operating expense
Income earned from cash deposits, short-term investments, and other interest-bearing assets
Income or loss before income tax expense; used as the denominator when computing the effective tax rate for NOPAT calculations
Total income tax provision for the period, including current and deferred components; used as the numerator of the effective tax rate
Net income or net loss after all expenses and taxes; the bottom line of the income statement. Also appears as the opening line of the cash flow statement under the indirect reconciliation method.
Cash on hand plus short-term liquid investments with original maturities of three months or less
Amounts owed by customers for goods or services delivered; reported net of allowances for doubtful accounts
Raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods held for sale; reported net of any reserves or write-downs
Sum of all assets expected to be converted to cash or consumed within one year
Tangible long-lived assets including land, buildings, machinery, and equipment, reported net of accumulated depreciation
Excess of acquisition purchase price over the fair value of net identifiable assets acquired; subject to annual impairment testing rather than amortization
Non-physical long-lived assets such as patents, trademarks, customer relationships, and acquired software; typically net of accumulated amortization and excluding goodwill
Sum of all assets on the balance sheet; equals total liabilities plus total equity
Amounts owed to suppliers for goods or services received but not yet paid; a key working capital component
Borrowings due within one year, including revolving credit facilities, commercial paper, and other short-term debt instruments
Principal payments on long-term debt obligations scheduled to come due within the next twelve months; reclassified from long-term debt
Cash received from customers for goods or services not yet delivered; a liability that converts to revenue as performance obligations are satisfied
Sum of all obligations due within one year; key denominator in liquidity ratios
Interest-bearing debt obligations due after one year, including bonds, notes payable, and term loans
Total interest-bearing debt; sum of long-term debt, short-term borrowings, and current portion of long-term debt
Sum of all obligations on the balance sheet; equals total assets minus total equity
Cumulative net income retained in the business after dividends paid; a component of stockholders equity
Total stockholders equity; includes common stock, additional paid-in capital, retained earnings, and accumulated other comprehensive income
Net cash provided by or used in operating activities; the primary measure of cash generation from core business operations

Non-cash charges for the periodic reduction in value of tangible and intangible assets. Primarily found as a reconciling add-back under operating activities in the cash flow statement; may also appear as a separate line in the income statement for some companies.
Non-cash expense for equity awards granted to employees; added back as a reconciling item under operating activities in the indirect method cash flow statement
Cash paid to acquire or improve property, plant, and equipment; reported as a cash outflow under investing activities
Cash dividends distributed to shareholders; reported as a cash outflow under financing activities
